info.name: CompetencyHub
info.description:
Run folder 0 first: it logs in as the seeded admin (dev profile, password123) and registers a fresh student. Requests without their own auth use {{adminToken}}; student and mentor steps carry their own tokens.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner works). Each create request saves the new id into a collection variable, so later requests use it automatically.

Folder 3 creates real submissions, so folder 4's 409 checks work without any SQL. (Before submissions had an endpoint, this was the manual way:)

docker exec competencyhub-db psql -U chub -d competencyhub -c "INSERT INTO submission (student_id, assessment_id, score, submitted_at) VALUES ((SELECT min(id) FROM student), <objectiveId>, 90, now())"
